scripts.clean: powershell -Command "$ports = 3000..3010 + 5000; Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $ports -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; exit 0"
scripts.all: npm run clean && concurrently -n "SERVER,FRONTEND" -c "green,blue" "npm run server" "npm run dev"
